last_dungeon.potion.found: Yes! There's a recovery potion lying on the ground.
last_dungeon.futon.found: Huh? Someone laid out a futon here. Maybe I can get some rest.
last_dungeon.key.found: There's a key on the ground. I'll just grab it.
last_dungeon.panel.intro: This is the Warp Panel that leads to Yokotank's Fortress...
last_dungeon.panel.menu.title: Choose an action.
last_dungeon.panel.menu.items: Think about it a bit more
last_dungeon.panel.collected: You picked up the Warp Panel...
last_dungeon.warp.warning: The next time you come back to this land, it will be after everything is over. Also, a boss battle starts right after the warp. And there are no more item shops from here on. You should get fully prepared before heading to your final destination.
last_dungeon.fort.arrive1: Did Yokotank build it? Or did he just take over something that was already here?
Whatever. I'm going in. Through that door right in front of me!
last_dungeon.fort.arrive2: ???: Looks like you finally made it, nyaa.
{player}: Yeah. Got a problem with that?
last_dungeon.fort.yamijin_talk: Yamijin: I'm impressed you managed to beat the likes of Gakishonen and Lord Yokotank's minions, nyaa.
{player}: Huh? Minions? What are you talking about?
Yamijin: Huh? That big giant robot. That was one of Lord Yokotank's minions.
{player}: Oh, so that's what it was... Well, I smashed it to pieces.
Yamijin: What a horrible thing to do. Do you have any idea how much money it cost to build that thing?
{player}: How should I know? Anyway, it attacked me, so I smashed it.
Enough. We've got no time for small talk.
Yamijin. This is our final battle, you and me.
Yamijin: Bring it on! I'll show you my true power!
last_dungeon.fort.battle_cry: {player}: I'm going to win, no matter what. I won't let you do as you please!
last_dungeon.fort.after_battle: {player}: Looks like it. Too bad for you.
Yamijin: I lost the fight. So it's right that I die. Finish me off.
last_dungeon.kill.after: {player}: Now, this time for real, here I go! Hyaaaaah!
last_dungeon.spare.speech: {player}: No. I... I hate killing... and I especially hate killing someone I don't have to kill!
Everything that's alive was born with some kind of meaning to its life, right?!
Maybe we don't know what that meaning is. Maybe it's not even a good one.
But any life at all can make someone it cares about happy!
The meaning of life. Isn't it to believe in the ones you love, help each other out, and live a happy life together?!
{player}: I'm going to stop Yokotank. I don't care what you think.
And I'm never going to kill you. No matter what you say, even if you try to kill yourself!
Anyway, I have to go further in.
Wait here. And don't you dare die on me!
With that, {player} turned his back on Yamijin and started walking toward the door...
